paragraphs: 4+ years of experience fueling the growth of business owners, executive teams, and creative visionaries through a blend of general support, executive assistance, podcast management, and digital marketing.

I build the infrastructure that allows you to scale with confidence, creating organizational harmony so you can focus on the big picture while daily operations run with precision.
